Here are two versions of a recommended letter. The only difference is

Version 1

I recently learned that I have been misinformed about the facts

 surrounding Jeffrey Epstein's conviction several years ago and that
statements that have been attributed to me are false. For this, I
deeply apologize.

Mr. Epstein is not a pedophile by any definition of the word.
[According to public records, he was convicted of procuring a person
under the age of 18 for prostitution, for he has served his time.] [It
is my understanding that this involved a woman just a few months short
of her 18th birthday.]

While I am disappointed and of course disapprove of some of the choices
he has made, the Jeffrey Epstein I knew was a kind and very generous
man, both to people in need and to the greater community in which he
lives. It is not only his support of science for the greater good that
so impressed me, but his support of so many humanitarian causes like the
Starlight Children's Foundation, which aids critically ill children and
their families cope with their pain, fear and isolation, the Nelson
Mandela Children's Fund, the Save Darfur Coalition, the Intrepid Fallen
Heroes Fund, The Robin Hood Foundation, which targets poverty in New
York City and scores of others.

As a Christian we are taught to forgive. Mr. Epstein has admitted the
errors of his ways and paid for those mistakes. He is focusing his life
on helping others. We should all do the same.
